messages:
priya: Heads up — canary promotion for release `canary-2026-03-21` failed on staging CI, deploy-bot paused the promotion.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: job `ci/staging/image-extract` failed with permission error. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/1768604999
michael: Link looks like the tar extraction step failed inside the runner.
priya: Excerpt from the job log below:
```
[2026-03-21T11:23:12Z] extracting layer 4/7
tar: ./usr/local/bin/redwood-server: Cannot change permissions to 0755: Permission denied
ERROR: failed to unpack layer: Operation not permitted
ERROR: exit status 1
```
jess: That's odd — we only changed the base image last week to `ubuntu:22.04-minimal` to shrink size. Could be rootless extraction behavior on the new runner images.
dan: Reproduced locally on a rootless container host: `tar -x` of the image fails for some entries due to fowner/fperm flags. Looks like umask or overlay fs differences.
priya: Can we pin back to the previous base image (last-good sha `sha256:abcdef1234`) to unblock the canary? Change window is open now.
deploy-bot: Manual pin/unblock allowed. Automatic promotion remains blocked until CI passes. To proceed you'll need manual promote after a green run and approvals.
sarah: +1 to pin. We should not hold the entire release for this; pin and follow up with root cause investigation.
michael: I'll prepare a tiny PR to revert the Dockerfile base to the pinned sha and trigger a staging pipeline. Will include a note in the PR describing the extraction permission failure.
dan: Also adding a CI job that runs a rootless image extract check so we catch this earlier.
priya: Once the PR lands, please tag me. Who can approve the manual promote?
jess: I can approve once the staged CI shows the wheel build step succeeded. :thumbsup!
deploy-bot: CI pipeline for PR #5421 (pin base) started.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline completed for PR #5421 — STATUS: success (all checks green).
priya: OK I'm going to request manual promote now.
priya: /promote canary-2026-03-21 --manual
deploy-bot: Promotion request recorded. Required approvals: eng-release (jess), eng-sre (sarah).
jess: Approved.
sarah: Approved.
deploy-bot: Promotion started. Canary rollout 0% -> 10% -> 30% -> 60%.
deploy-bot: Canary health checks OK at 60%, no errors observed in staging logs. Promotion complete.
priya: Unblocked and promoted. Leaving a follow-up ticket to investigate root cause across rootless runners and the ubuntu:22.04-minimal base image behavior.
sarah: Adding a short note for the release: "Temporarily pinned base image due to image extraction permission errors on rootless runners; regression investigation in follow-up." Will include in release notes.
michael: Thanks everyone — rolling this out to the rest of the fleet under the change window. We'll track the RCA in ticket RW-3719.
priya: Closing thread — thanks for quick turnaround.
